scopeBoundaryReview.finding: Apple's watchOS 7 announcement directly says watchOS would be offered as a public beta for the first time, independently echoed by 9to5Mac. Pre-watchOS 7 major cycles are therefore not applicable to this public-beta chronology.

notProposedReviews.finding: The only affirmative retained row is iCulture's later chronology. Contemporary 9to5Mac reporting says public testers still had to wait after the developer release, the retained MacRumors archive does not record a watchOS public appearance before August 18, and the surviving publisher chronology is internally disputed.
notProposedReviews.requiredHandling: Treat this as a conservative do-not-create decision, not as proof that the appearance was impossible. Reverse it only with affirmative contemporary public-channel evidence.

packetQualifications.subject: Over-broad candidate evidence descriptions
packetQualifications.finding: Several candidate evidenceRefs use generic support text that overstates what the cited source proves. In particular, iMore calls the July 28 watchOS 8 appearance Public Beta 3, gives Public Beta 8 the duplicate August 26 date, and gives the first watchOS 9 public beta the developer date of July 6. AppleInsider's watchOS 10 Public Beta 2 report is dated August 1 rather than July 31.
packetQualifications.requiredHandling: Use the per-candidate findings and qualifications in this review instead of the generic evidenceRef support sentence when building or citing chronology.

packetQualifications.subject: Retained evidence boundary
packetQualifications.finding: The review reproduced the locked files and all 49 raw source hashes. Living chronology pages can change later; the retained captures and hashes are the evidence of record.
packetQualifications.requiredHandling: Do not replace retained historical claims with silently changed live-page text.
